label: Promo signal (chip + headline + bottom art)
description: Carousel-ad content slide on a light frame: an accent chip badge top-left (icon + label), a display headline, a short label + body block, and a baked art composite (UI mock, device, cards) anchored to the bottom edge. Extends the promo-* family (1080x1920) with the --brand-accent token (lime fallback from the Vidext 'Carrusel señales' reference). Art composites bake the paper background in, so they are per-episode assets.
